title: Mod-erate Loading Screen Modernised
description: Makes mods fall down the screen while it is loading. Original mod by enjarai
body:
Edit: apparently owo-lib is not on 26.2 for some reason, this will be updated as soon as owo-lib is on modern.

This is an updated port of [Mod-erate Loading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/moderate-loading-screen) by enjarai to modern versions of Minecraft. It makes all of your mods fall down the screen like snowflakes during the resource reload. 

![Snowflakes mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/017911b186f4dcea66775be9c5d48367234aac59.gif)

_Snowflakes mode, taken with [Splashfox](https://modrinth.com/mod/splashfox)._

Alternatively, you can use stacking mode:

![Stacking Mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/350e8d718b4bf2f0d54841c92465198acfbf1149.gif)

_Also taken with [Splashfox](https://modrinth.com/mod/splashfox)._

You can easily configure the options through ModMenu: 

![ModMenu Config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd1f0da1c836e8091492510487c64871509b4f8c_0.webp)

**Improvements from the original version:**

- Fade out animation (works better in stacking mode than snowflakes)
- Removed dependency on CICADA (it was literally doing nothing idek why it was there)
